No. GlowTV is a player only. You add a playlist or server account from a provider you are entitled to use. No channels or subscriptions are included.
Yes. The player is free. Optional support helps its development and does not unlock channels or features. Your content provider may charge separately.
You can connect with an M3U or M3U8 playlist URL, import an M3U file, or sign in to your provider with Xtream Codes. A stream manifest is not a channel playlist.
Do I need a GlowTV account?
No. Your provider profiles and settings stay on your device. You can transfer them with an encrypted backup protected by a password you choose.
How do I load the TV guide?
Add your provider’s XMLTV URL in the Guide. Programme information depends on your provider and matching channel IDs. Empty schedules do not mean the player is broken.
Catch-up is available for completed programmes when your Xtream provider explicitly supports it and the programme is inside its archive window.
Does a different public IP prove my VPN is connected?
No. GlowTV can compare your public IP with a home reference. A changed address is not proof of a VPN or a secure connection.
Can I cast to another screen?
Compatible native playback on iOS supports AirPlay and picture-in-picture. Availability depends on the stream and playback engine. Chromecast is not currently supported.

in.</h2><details><summary>Does GlowTV include TV channels?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>No. GlowTV is a player only. You add a playlist or server account from a provider you are entitled to use. No channels or subscriptions are included.</p></details><details><summary>Is GlowTV free?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Yes. The player is free. Optional support helps its development and does not unlock channels or features. Your content provider may charge separately.</p></details><details><summary>Which playlists can I add?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>You can connect with an M3U or M3U8 playlist URL, import an M3U file, or sign in to your provider with Xtream Codes. A stream manifest is not a channel playlist.</p></details><details><summary>Do I need a GlowTV account?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>No. Your provider profiles and settings stay on your device. You can transfer them with an encrypted backup protected by a password you choose.</p></details><details><summary>How do I load the TV guide?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Add your provider’s XMLTV URL in the Guide. Programme information depends on your provider and matching channel IDs. Empty schedules do not mean the player is broken.</p></details><details><summary>Can I watch past programmes?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Catch-up is available for completed programmes when your Xtream provider explicitly supports it and the programme is inside its archive window.</p></details><details><summary>Does a different public IP prove my VPN is connected?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>No. GlowTV can compare your public IP with a home reference. A changed address is not proof of a VPN or a secure connection.</p></details><details><summary>Can I cast to another screen?<span aria-hidden="true">+</span></summary><p>Compatible native playback on iOS supports AirPlay and picture-in-picture. Availability depends on the stream and playback engine.
